name: Motion
description: The Porsche Design System provides a consistent motion system with duration and easing values for creating smooth and meaningful animations and transitions.

duration.description: Duration values for controlling the timing of animations and transitions.

values.name: Short
values.description: Short duration for quick transitions like hover states or small UI changes.

values.name: Moderate
values.description: Moderate duration for standard transitions like expanding panels or showing/hiding elements.

values.name: Long
values.description: Long duration for more significant transitions like page transitions or complex animations.

easing.description: Easing functions for controlling the acceleration and deceleration of animations and transitions.

values.name: Base
values.description: Standard easing function for most transitions, with smooth acceleration and deceleration.

values.name: In
values.description: Easing function for elements entering the screen or becoming visible, with gradual acceleration.

values.name: Out
values.description: Easing function for elements leaving the screen or becoming hidden, with gradual deceleration.

patterns.description: Common motion patterns for specific use cases.

values.name: Moving
values.description: Pattern for moving elements from one position to another.

values.name: Enter/Exit
values.description: Pattern for elements entering or exiting the screen.

values.name: Show/Hide
values.description: Pattern for showing or hiding elements with opacity.

values.name: Expand
values.description: Pattern for expanding or collapsing elements.
